title: Netflix Confirms U.S. Release Date for Major 2026 Shonen Jump Revival Movie
content: Netflix has locked down one of the major anime movies releasing this year, and has set a release date for a major return of a Shonen Jump franchise. This year has been fairly strong for anime movies thus far with many new releases that fans have been keeping an eye out for.
author: ComicBook

title: Marvel x Kadokawa Team Up for New Spider-Man Manga & More With First Look at Major Makeovers
content: Marvel and Kadokawa have announced that they are teaming up on wave of new manga releases for some of their biggest heroes, and the first look has revealed some major makeovers for Spider-Man, The Punisher and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Toho Just Launched a New English Dub Perfect for The Apothecary Diaries Fans
content: The Apothecary Diaries fans can scratch that itch with a cool new anime now streaming this Summer, and Toho has officially kicked off the English dub for the anime that’s really heating up July.
author: ComicBook

title: 22 Years Later, Iconic Shonen Jump Anime Has Entered Its Final Phase
content: 2026 is an exciting year for Bleach fans since the anime is about to fully adapt the manga. The original Bleach anime, which premiered in 2004, stopped airing in 2012, leaving several questions unanswered.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Season 2 Director Explains Why It Looks Much Better Than Season 1
content: Black Clover is currently in the works on finally coming back to screens with Season 2 of the anime after five long years , and the director behind the new episodes explained why it’s already looking so much better this time around.
author: ComicBook

title: Don’t Worry, Avatar: Seven Havens Won’t Dump All Its Episodes at Once
content: Avatar: Seven Havens will be making its official streaming debut later this year, but thankfully the series won’t be dropping all of its episodes at once as previously reported so fans can breathe easy.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Finally Streams a Classic Anime’s Missing Episodes After 13 Years
content: 13 years after they originally released, Crunchyroll has finally locked down an official streaming release for a classic anime’s episodes that were previously exclusive to Japan.
author: ComicBook

title: Family Guy Season 25 First Look Trailer Teases New 2027 Episodes
content: Family Guy is coming back for its next full season of episodes next year, and is getting fans ready for what’s next with the first look trailer showing it all off. title: Konosuba Season 4 First Look Trailer Reveals Major Changes Behind the Scenes
content: Konosuba is now in the works on Season 4 of the anime at last, and fans have finally gotten the first look at what to expect from the new episodes. Konosuba: God’s Blessing on this Wonderful World!
author: ComicBook

title: The Transformers: The Movie Screens in U.S., U.K. With 'New Post-Credits Chapter' on September 17
content: Fathom Events and Hasbro announced on Friday that their upcoming 4K re-release of The Transformers: The Movie in theaters in the United States and United Kingdom on September 17 (" Transformers Day") will feature extra footage in the form of a never-before-seen "cinematic chapter" that will screen after credits.
author: ANN
